title: Advanced Business Data Structures and Computer Algorithms: Main Exam, 23 August 2019
unitTitle: Advanced Business Data Structures and Computer Algorithms
instructions: QUESTION ONE IS COMPULSORY. ANSWER ANY OTHER TWO QUESTIONS

parts.text: Define the term algorithm.
Explain any three categories of algorithms.
Explain three performance factors to consider when choosing an algorithm to use.
Using examples, differentiate between a local optimal solution and a global optimal solution of an algorithm.
In reference to the greedy algorithm, explain the following concepts.
A candidate set
An objective function
A solution function
Explain two advantages of the greedy algorithm.
With the help of illustrative diagrams, explain the difference between a binary search tree (BST) and a heap tree.
Using the N-Queens puzzle game, explain the backtracking algorithm.
With the help of a relevant diagram, explain the Big-Omega (Ω) notation and its relevance in representing algorithm performance.
With relevant examples, discuss the following divide and conquer techniques.
Merge sort
Max-min problem
Explain the following backtracking function syntax.
reject(P,c)
accept(P,c)
first(P,c)
output(P,c)
Explain the following functions as a measure of computing operation performance.
f(n)
g(n²)
Explain three benefits of studying algorithm analysis in computer science.
The space complexity of an algorithm is expressed as S(P) = C + SP(I). Explain.
Explain the travelling salesman problem.
Quick sort is similar to merge sort in using the divide and conquer technique. Explain these techniques and show how each of the algorithms utilizes the divide and conquer technique.
State the differences between the quick sort and merge sort algorithms.
Merge sort has a running time in the order of O(n log2 n) on average. Explain this statement.
